paper.title_en: Spacelike solitons of the r-th mean curvature flow in pp-wave spacetimes
paper.abstract_en: Our aim in this paper is to investigate geometric conditions which guarantee the nonexistence of spacelike solitons of the r-th mean curvature flow (shortly, r-MCF) in a pp-wave spacetime, namely, a $(n+1)$-dimensional connected Lorentzian manifold admitting a parallel lightlike vector field, where $n\ge 2$ and $r\in \{1,\ldots ,n\}$. Our approach is based on three main analytical frameworks: a Liouville type result, a maximum principle for complete noncompact Riemannian manifolds with polynomial volume growth or satisfying a certain convergence at infinity, and a suitable version of the Omori-Yau maximum principle. Furthermore, we also exhibit nice nontrivial examples of spacelike solitons of the r-MCF in a pp-wave spacetime, showing that the main hypotheses that we assume in our nonexistence results are, indeed, necessary.
